CustomField.description: The Line Status field displayed to customers on E-Commerce platform.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISPICKVAL (Line_Status__c, "Open"), "Open", IF(ISPICKVAL (Line_Status__c, "In Process"), "Open", IF(ISPICKVAL (Line_Status__c, "Ready for Pickup"), "Open", IF(ISPICKVAL (Line_Status__c, "Backordered"), "Open", IF(ISPICKVAL (Line_Status__c, "Order Received"), "Open", IF(ISPICKVAL (Line_Status__c, "Shipping"), "Open", IF(ISPICKVAL (Line_Status__c, "Complete"), "Complete", IF(ISPICKVAL (Line_Status__c, "Cancelled"), "Cancelled", "-"))))))))
CustomField.label: E-Commerce Line Item Status
